scouting_result.pathway_adaptive: Seated Shot Put (e.g., Women's Shot Put C3)
scouting_result.scout_verdict:
Your journey as a lifelong competitor in strength and power disciplines has forged a foundation of raw, controlled aggression that is perfect for the throwing circle. At 182.0cm and 142.0kg, you possess the ideal mass-to-leverage ratio required to master the technical nuances of the shot put and discus. Your drive for personal refinement—rather than just the glory of the podium—is exactly the mindset required to survive the repetitive, high-stakes cycles of training that define this pathway.

As you stand in the center of the ring, the focus isn't on the crowd; it is on that singular, perfect release. For an athlete of your experience, the dream of representing your country at The Brisbane 2032 Games is not just about the medal, but about the culmination of a career spent chasing the limits of your own biomechanical potential. Your age is your greatest asset here; at 35, you possess the mental discipline to translate your power into world-class performance.

scouting_result.scout_verdict:
Your history of strength training is the engine room for a transition into the high-velocity, high-impact world of push sports. Bobsleigh is a discipline where pure force meets physics, and your significant body mass allows you to generate the explosive kinetic transfer needed to launch a sled into the frozen chute. You have spent your life mastering your own body—now, you would be mastering the art of moving a team of iron and steel at breakneck speeds.

In this arena, your commitment to shattering your own records becomes a tactical advantage. The transition from the gym to the ice at The Milano Cortina 2026 Games requires that same obsessive attention to detail you have cultivated over your long athletic journey. You are not just pushing a sled; you are orchestrating a complex, high-performance sequence where every millisecond is a testament to the strength and grit you’ve spent a lifetime building.
